It is advised to get a good coaching while you prepare for IELTS. This is mainly because; knowing English alone will not help you clear your IELTS exam. Even though this is a fact, many students choose to have self-study for IELTS. Casper Academy of Excellence is the best IELTS coaching centre in Kochi to give intensive coaching. Now we can clear this addressing certain things.

Challenges Faced by an IELTS Test Taker

Now, let us assume that, you already have the advantage of having received your formal education in an English medium school. Otherwise, you will require IELTS coaching to clear the exam as you will barely know the basics of the language. So, getting back to the challenges, we can address them one by one.

  • Procrastination – You will definitely have the desire to chill a bit, as you have one more month left for preparation. It is a trap that will be too tempting to avoid. With this, we will repeatedly keep postponing our plans, works and resolutions. Self-study needs dedication and that has to come from within. If you find it difficult to curb your urge for procrastination a bit more, self-study will end up in affecting your self-confidence. This will directly affect your IELTS band score. Casper Academy of Excellence is the best IELTS training centre in Ernakulam helping students to get through all the four modules of IELTS easily.
  • Lack of Responsibility – When there is a monetary value attached to something, you will consider it seriously by yourself or by others who push you to make use of it. While confidence in your learning ability may take the seriousness that the exam requires, it will loss you money as you end up scoring less and want to attend exam again.
  • Use of Time – If preparing for IELTS is not the only thing in your bucket list and you have multiple tasks to do in your day-to-day life, self-learning can give you flexibility. Thus you will end up in deciding to do ‘it’ later.
  • Too Many Cooks –To gain information, we will see for videos in YouTube or will go for most articles, blogs and pdfs. The problem with this is, you will only get information in bits. Moreover, there will be too many people telling you the same thing in different ways. There are chances to lose your band scores due to misdirection or with assumptions.
  • Tips and Strategies – There are definitely a lot of tips and tricks while IELTS preparation. These tricks will definitely help you to overcome your weakness while preparation and attempting the IELTS exam. You will lose this, when you are choosing self-study.
